    for color in colors:
        pieces = [cells for col, cells in objects if col == color]
        pieces.sort(key=lambda cells: min(r for r, c in cells))
        lane = 0 if color == left_color else 4
        for i, cells in enumerate(pieces):
            minr = min(r for r, c in cells)
            minc = min(c for r, c in cells)
            top = 5 if i == 0 else 8
            for r, c in cells:
                y = top + r - minr
                x = lane + c - minc
                if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                    out[y][x] = color
    return out
